name: GFX_hof_ic_khrushchev_the_purchase_prices
title: 收购价格
concept: A single open purchase-price SHEET on a cool gray desk, its price rows represented by small illegible gray marks and a neutral embossed seal with NO RED INK. Beside the sheet lies a SMALL BUNDLE OF REAL WHEAT EARS laid flat diagonally, tactile and wheat-yellow. The wheat is the sole vivid CENTRAL color, brighter than the preceding icons. A still-life of paper and agricultural produce, not a heraldic central sheaf, no corn, no people, no legible text.
prompt: Create ONE finished Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon. Use attached image ONLY as stylistic reference for the shared outer engraved GOLD laurel wreath, small RED star and blank gold ribbon; create a NEW central scene.
